verdict.rationale: Railway's docs say you can develop locally with the Railway CLI and describe the platform as making it easy to develop locally, so local development is claimed. Nothing in the pack describes a local simulator or emulator, or any guarantee that the local environment matches the production runtime. missing for 10: a documented local simulator/emulator, production-runtime parity (build, networking, env), details of how the CLI's local-dev workflow works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
